accepted.title: The prime field is not a maximal clique in GP(5^8,3): a counterexample to Yip's maximal subfield clique conjecture

source_targets: Yip, J. Algebraic Combin. 56(2) (2022) 323-333, arXiv:2101.09652 Conjecture 1.4
accepted.substantive_reason: Refutes in exact universal scope a published conjecture that its author later announced as confirmed and a 2025 paper restates as proved without the size hypothesis; also shows the explicit remark that q>(n-1)^2 can be dropped is false. Not implied by any known theorem; lies outside the source computer checks (n<=5; n=6, q<=17).

accepted.title: Complete bipartite graphs maximise sigma_t-irregularity among connected triangle-free graphs
accepted.scope: For every n>=2 and every maximiser a of a(n-a)(n-2a)^2 over 1<=a<n, K_{a,n-a} is connected, triangle-free and has sigma_t at least that of every connected triangle-free graph on n vertices; every attainer is complete bipartite with nonempty parts. Proves arXiv:2411.04881v1 Conjecture 24 / Ars Math. Contemp. 26 (2026) Conjecture 6.1 in full.

accepted.title: A 34-vertex maximal rigid diameter-5 subset of the eight-dimensional Hamming cube
accepted.scope: Explicit 34-point subset of signed Q_8 with diameter exactly 5, inclusion-maximal subject to diameter <= 5, and a diameter partner at every point; hence b'(8;5) >= 34 > 32, refuting Briggs-Feng-Wells Conjecture 1 (b'(n;r)=2^r for n>=r).
source_targets: Briggs-Feng-Wells, Facets in the Vietoris-Rips complexes of hypercubes, arXiv:2408.01288 v1/v2, Section 6 Conjecture 1
accepted.substantive_reason: Refutes the conjectured extremal size in the central domain (n=8, r=5); the source Hadamard/product/fixed-coordinate constructions cannot exceed 2^r, and known maximum-anticode results (Kleitman, Ahlswede-Katona via Bezrukov 1987), Helly-type bounds and linear anticode bounds do not yield a rigid inclusion-maximal set above 2^r.
